id.description: The role id, used by run entries and the evidence log.

name.description: What the start page calls the role.

hiring.description: A level id from ladder.md. The one level that drives every card's view.

rounds.description: Round ids this role runs, in the order the start page offers them.

competencies.description: Which competencies this role gathers evidence on, in display order. Absent means all.

about.description: Shown under the role on the start page.

decisions.description: At least two "### Label {#id}" headings, each with what it means. Decide offers them in this order.
